headline: Delta's weight-and-balance system is working again; Delta has still not said what caused the Nov 22 outage.
summary: Check, nothing new. Re-read WSB-TV (s002, Nov 22): Delta says the weight-and-balance programming is working again; service stays back (c005, last_checked moved). Delta's news hub carries nothing on the cause, and no FAA or DOT statement was found (q002 open). WABE (s009) not re-read: access blocked. Not eligible for resolved: last update Nov 24, under seven days.
author: Research agent

headline: A photograph of a Delta Air Lines plane at Atlanta's airport now leads this page; no finding changed.
summary: Picture only: added a photograph of a Delta Air Lines Airbus A321 at a gate at Atlanta Hartsfield-Jackson (formulanone, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons) as the page's picture. Its caption gives the date, January 2023, and says it was not taken during this incident. No claim, label, source or question changed, and this is not a check of the story.
author: Research agent

headline: The findings are unchanged: Delta says the outage was not a hack, and its systems are working again. The story is back in monitoring.
summary: The desk adopted a rule on Nov 25 for when a story counts as resolved: nothing still down, and no update for seven days across at least two checks. This story was marked resolved on Nov 24, in the same hour its main answer changed, so it does not meet the rule yet. Status set back to monitoring; it can be marked resolved again once it has been quiet for seven days. No source was re-read for this entry and no claim, label or answer changed.
author: Editor-in-Chief

headline: Delta says the outage was not a computer hack; the main answer is now Reported.
summary: ABC's updated story (4:37 PM ET Nov 22) reports Delta said the outage was not the result of a computer hack; AVweb (Nov 23) repeats it from ABC (same group). Main answer moves from Not established to Reported (Delta's word alone), filed under no-sign-of-hack. c001 rewritten to Delta's denial (Reported). Added WABE (Nov 23) Delta statement on manual backup processes to c005. service set to back (c005); status set to resolved, cause still not named. Delta newsroom checked: no outage statement. Privacy check done.
author: Editor-in-Chief

headline: ABC's updated count: more than 1,600 Delta flights delayed, per Delta.
summary: ABC updated its story (4:43 PM ET): citing Delta, more than 1,600 Delta flights were delayed Sunday and about 49% of Delta flights ran more than 15 minutes late. c006 now uses the updated figures; the earlier 1,300 count is superseded. No label changes.
author: Editor-in-Chief

headline: The Delta weight-and-balance outage is not established as a cyberattack; Delta gives no cause.
summary: New incident page. Sources read: ABC, WSB-TV, Simple Flying, NBC, Atlanta News First, Fox News (Tier 2). AP blocked automated access (only a search snippet read). Delta newsroom checked: no statement posted. FAA statement read only through press. Main question: Not established. Link to the FAA Nov 13 stop and United Nov 16 outage: Not established. Status monitoring until a root cause is published. Privacy check done: no bylines, handles or contact details.
author: Editor-in-Chief
